jobs.occupation: Data Center Technician II, Global Server Operations
jobs.description:
**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience in diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems and computer/server hardware or networking protocols.

• Experience with performing component-level repairs on IT equipment.

• Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and to exert physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.

• Must have the ability to work non-standard hours, including weekends, holidays and on shift-based schedule as required.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Certification in online Google IT Support Professional Certificate program.

• 2 years of experience in diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems and computer/server hardware or networking protocols.

• Experience in working within a data center or network operation center environment.

• Ability to collaborate and partner with teams to overcome tests.

• Ability to adapt to changes in a changing work environment.

**About The Job

**Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.600000 - kr.615000 (DKK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities

**Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or functions.

• Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose straightforward issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and apply the resources needed to resolve identified issues.

• Maintain the security and integrity of data, track various forms of media to check for standard data security issues (e.g., data was not properly erased) handled in accordance with Google security standards.

• Disassemble specific equipment that has reached its end-of-life via part replacement or maintenance, in a team setting.

• Repair, fix, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, or infrastructure based on identified issues with defined solutions.

jobs.occupation: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Building keeps getting cheaper every quarter. What used to take a senior engineer a few weeks now takes an afternoon. The work that does not get cheaper is helping a real business absorb new technology, sequencing the rollout, and knowing when to slow down because something is starting to break under load.

At Heyra, we build operational AI: systems, workflows, and data platforms that live in production from day one. We work with companies that are moving quickly and need solutions that improve the way they operate.

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer. Someone who goes into a client, understands the operation, spots where the real optimisation potential sits, and pushes it all the way through to execution with a strong engineering team behind them.

The role sits between engineering and consulting without fitting cleanly into either. You need to be technical enough to understand data and AI at a deep level. Commercial enough to spot where the business value sits. Patient enough to sit with a manager who is genuinely worried about the tool you just put in front of them. And stubborn enough to stay around once the launch excitement fades and the real adoption work begins.

Most people are strong in one of those. Some in two. Almost nobody walks in with all four. That is exactly the profile we are looking for.

What you will work on

You will embed directly with clients to understand the operation and where the real value sits. You will drive adoption by sequencing rollouts, working with the people who have to use the tool, and staying through the unglamorous part. You will translate business needs into AI solutions that actually ship. And you will learn when to push, when to slow down, and when something is starting to break under load.

You work closely with engineers, data specialists, strategists, and designers in a company where the distance from thinking to building is intentionally small.

**Requirements

**Experience with management consulting, change management, or adoption of AI solutions in production. An understanding of software development, ML or data engineering. Familiarity with AI and GenAI frameworks, possibly with some MLOps and evals exposure. Experience with cloud environments like Azure or GCP.

Coding with agents like Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. Working directly with clients and stakeholders. Owning delivery end to end, from a vague problem to a live, adopted solution.

Curiosity, taste and a builder mentality matter just as much to us as specific tools or years of experience.

Why Heyra

We believe consulting needs to be rewritten. We are building a consultancy designed for the agentic era. We design, build and operate AI products that change how enterprises work, from problem to prototype to production.

Heyra brings together people from engineering, strategy, product, startup and creative environments. We keep teams small, collaboration close and momentum high. We care deeply about craft, speed and building things that work in the real world.

People here care about what they build. Good ideas move quickly. New technology gets explored early. There is room to shape both the company and the way we work.

We are around 45 people today, and we are only just getting started.

If this sounds like your kind of work, send us a short note about yourself together with your CV. We care much more about curiosity, energy and the way you think than polished applications.

**Benefits

**

• Healthcare insurance

• Pension plan

• Parental leave

• Social gatherings

• New tech gear

• Central office

• Free lunch, coffee, snacks, and Friday beers

• Skill development

• Paid holiday

**Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. Working with the Data, ML, Platform, and Product Engineering teams, you will keep ingestion, modelling, and orchestration dependable, and define the modelling, testing, and documentation standards the data function depends on. • Build the historical and low-latency foundations that make predictive and real-time use cases possible.

• Keep the platform reliable, performant, cost-effective, and compliant.

• Architecture that holds up as we scale and as new use cases emerge, and that other engineers follow as a pattern.

• Analysts ship faster and more efficiently because your tooling & standards remove friction.

• A drop in repeat requests to the data team, as stakeholders answer their own questions through agentic workflows.

• ML and product teams have the historical and real-time data they need, without bespoke workarounds.

• Strong working relationships with the Data, ML, and Platform teams.

• Deep, hands-on Snowflake and dbt experience: modelling, semantic layers, agents & skills, testing, performance and cost tuning.

• Production experience with a pipeline orchestrator, ideally Dagster (or similar Airflow, Prefect), including dependent workloads, partial failures, and observability.

• Modern cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS/GCP) and Kubernetes experience deploying and operating containerised workloads, plus infrastructure as code (Terraform).

• Strong SQL & Python for pipelines, services, and automation.

• Software engineering discipline across CI/CD, testing, and code review.

• The ability to turn technical trade-offs into clear narratives that help stakeholders decide and trust the work.

• Experience operating data systems, including incident response, cost, and data privacy practices.

Are you passionate about turning complex information into clear business insights? Do you enjoy asking questions, challenging assumptions and investigating unexpected trends to understand the business behind the numbers, not just reporting them?

We are looking for a skilled and business-oriented Business Controller to join our Finance & Controlling team. This is a full-time role based in Copenhagen, structured as a hybrid position that combines office presence with some work-from-home flexibility.

What is the job about?

As a Business Controller, you will be much more than the owner of reports and forecasts. You will act as a trusted business partner, helping our management team understand what is happening in the business, why it is happening and what we should do next.

You will work across our insurance operations in Denmark, Sweden and Norway, partnering closely with colleagues in Claims, Sales, Underwriting, Operations, Finance, IT and other business functions to improve business performance. Through high-quality financial controlling, analysis and reporting, you will provide reliable insights and ensure transparency, accuracy and compliance.

Your qualifications

• Experience in Business Controlling, FP&A or another finance business partnering role is required.

• Strong analytical and commercial mindset, with experience analysing business performance.

• Experience with or understanding of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and business planning.

• Ability to communicate complex financial topics clearly to non-financial stakeholders.

• Experience with Excel and BI tools, combined with the ability to use AI effectively

• Familiarity with ERP (e.g. SAP GT) systems is an advantage

• Experience working with large datasets and translating analysis into business recommendations.

• Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Relevant degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related discipline.

What will make you successful?

You’ll probably enjoy this role if you:

• Are genuinely curious about how businesses work.

• You are motivated by understanding complexity.

• Like asking “Why?” until you reach the root cause.

• You remain optimistic and persistent despite struggles.

• You like solving new problems along with routine tasks.

• Are comfortable making decisions without having every answer upfront.

• Build relationships across functions because you know the best insights rarely come from spreadsheets alone.

• Have the confidence to challenge assumptions, supported by facts rather than opinions.

• Take pride in helping others make better decisions through data and insight.

What we offer?

We offer an exciting opportunity to join a professional and collaborative finance environment where you can make a tangible impact on business performance.

You will have the opportunity to:

• Work with complex financial and business-related challenges

• Collaborate with experienced professionals across local and central / headquarter functions

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting, planning, and governance processes

• Further develop your technical expertise and business understanding

• Play an active role in supporting strategic and operational decision-making

If you are motivated by financial analysis, business partnering, and continuous improvement, we would love to hear from you.

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Department: Finance & Controlling

Reporting to: Head of Controlling

How to apply

If you would like to know more about the position, you are welcome to contact:

Edgards Baumanis

Nordic Head of Controlling

Email: Edgars.Baumanis@ergo.dk

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, please send your CV and application to hr@ergo.dk

We look forward to hearing from you!

Who we are

ERGO Forsikring A/S is one of the leading insurance companies in the Nordic region, formed through the merger of Europæiske Rejseforsikring A/S and ERGO Forsikring AS. The company provides health and travel insurance solutions in Denmark, Norway and Sweden. In Denmark, travel insurance is offered under the Europæiske ERV brand, which has more than 100 years of experience in safeguarding travellers, while health insurance is delivered to businesses under the ERGO Forsikring brand.

ERGO Forsikring A/S is part of ERGO Group AG, a major international insurance group and the primary insurance arm of Munich Re. You will join an organisation with strong regional roots and global backing, focused on reliability, customer security and long-term partnerships.

jobs.occupation: Team Assistant
jobs.description:
Directure is an international management consulting firm devoted to advising and assisting organisations within life science, healthcare and other regulated industries, to realise their strategy aspirations. We operate through an integrated approach to consulting, combining best practice standards and disciplines of Management Consulting, International Search and People Resource Consulting. Today, Directure advises a variety of companies that seek guidance and counselling on business and senior leadership needs with an increasing access to executives around the world. We combine the in-depth expertise of an international advisor with the focus and flexibility of a boutique consulting firm that has put impact above size.

Team Assistant

The Role

Directure's consultants run complex, multi-client advisory practices. They need someone close — someone who keeps the operational side running with precision while also contributing to the polished outputs clients receive.

The role is onsite and sits at the intersection of those characteristics. You will own the administrative infrastructure that keeps consultants effective — diary management, travel, planning, correspondence — and you will contribute directly to client deliverables: communications, reports and advanced PowerPoint presentations built to a consulting standard.

Responsibilities

Two distinct, equally important areas of work

Administration & Coordination

• Own and manage complex partner and consultant diaries — scheduling, sequencing, and protecting time for deep work

• Plan and coordinate all travel: flights, accommodation, ground logistics, and changes in the field

• Prepare meeting agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up actions; manage correspondence independently where appropriate

• Administrative coordination with Finance.

• Build and maintain advanced PowerPoint presentations — slide logic, visual hierarchy, data visualisation — to a standard appropriate for senior client audiences. Assist in preparing pitch materials, proposals, and thought-leadership content

• Quality-check outputs before client delivery: language, consistency, and visual finish

What We're Looking For

Skills, background, and ways of working

• An academic degree and + 2 years of FTE experience in a professional services, consulting, corporate, or equivalent environment — you understand what high-standard output looks like

• Strong PowerPoint skills are essential: you can build a structured, visually coherent presentation from a brief, not just populate a template

• Organised in a way that holds under pressure: priorities shift, deadlines accelerate, and you adapt without dropping things

• Excellent written communication in English – native or proficiency; your drafts need minimal editing before they go out

• Curious about the work itself — you want to understand the engagements you're supporting, not just manage the calendar around them

The remuneration reflects your qualifications.

How to Apply

Please send your CV and a brief cover letter under reference "TA" to career@directure.com. Please note that we will invite, interview and select among candidates on an ongoing basis. We look forward to receiving your application, which will be treated in strictest confidence.

For more information about Directure please visit: www.directure.com

jobs.occupation: Senior Technical Application Engineer
jobs.description:

**Key About Your Role

**You will connect functional knowledge of pension administration with technical application management and a serious interest in automating the work we do. By understanding both the business process, the technical side off the application and the application itself, you will help colleagues and customers identify why issues occur and how to resolve them.

You will:

• Investigate Plexus issues by tracing pension back-office processes through application behaviour, logs and SQL database queries.

• Work with SQL databases and Red Hat Linux environments to diagnose application and data issues, involving database and platform specialists where needed.

• Support Plexus environments hosted on our private Keylane Cloud and on Azure, working with the teams responsible for each platform.

• Coordinate application releases and maintenance, and verify that affected pension processes work correctly after changes.

• Translate functional problems into clear technical findings and explain the business impact of technical issues.

• Use scripts and practical documentation to make recurring support tasks easier and more reliable.

• Take a senior role in complex investigations, share your knowledge and help colleagues develop their approach to problem solving.

**Key About Your Team

**You will work with colleagues supporting Plexus and collaborate with functional specialists, developers and cloud operations teams. Together, you will connect the details of pension administration with the technical work needed to support the application.

**Requirements

**We welcome two professional backgrounds:

• Functional experience with a pension back-office system, combined with a serious interest in technology and a willingness to learn how applications, databases and operating environments work.

• Software development experience, combined with an interest in the business side of pension administration and a willingness to learn how pension processes are supported in Plexus.

Whichever route you bring, you can demonstrate the judgement and ownership expected of a senior colleague. You can work independently, recognize when specialist input is needed and help others move an investigation forward.

You also bring:

• Ideally 5 + years' experience in the field

• A structured approach to investigation, with the ability to connect business symptoms, application behavior and data.

• The ability to explain complex issues clearly in English and work effectively with technical and functional colleagues.

• An interest in hands-on application support and in developing your SQL and Red Hat Linux skills.

• Experience with SQL databases, Linux, scripting or cloud-hosted applications is an advantage. Familiarity with Azure or Plexus is welcome.

You do not need to arrive with equal depth in pension administration and technology. You should be ready to build the connection between them and apply your experience to real customer situations.

**Using AI

**You use AI-assisted tools with care when exploring technical questions, preparing scripts or documenting solutions. You review and test their output, protect customer information and remain accountable for the quality and security of your work.

A criminal record and reference check are part of the application process. Each employee within Keylane must follow training on information security and irrespective to the role basic information security responsibilities apply.

**

• A flat and informal organization with a professional and supportive working environment.

• A profit share.

• Inclusion days where you decide when to hold your public holidays.

• Five weeks of vacation and five Keylane days.

• A pension scheme where 13.25% is paid by Keylane and the individual contribution is 3%.

• Flexibility in the working environment. We offer a combination of working from home and from the office. We value seeing colleagues in person to stay connected and collaborate effectively.

• We believe that strong employee relations are key to maintaining well-being in the workplace. To support this, we offer a variety of social activities that all employees can participate in, such as yoga, padel tennis, running, outdoor bathing, and fitness in the basement.

jobs.occupation: Senior Peptide Scientist – Drug Discovery and Early Innovation
jobs.description:
Do you want to drive innovation and collaborate in an ever-evolving field of drug discovery?

Do you want to help decide which therapeutic ideas to pursue and generate the first experimental evidence to move them forward? In this role, you will apply your expertise in peptide synthesis and design for therapeutic applications, working across disciplines and organizational boundaries in an entrepreneurial setup. At Gubra, you can look forward to seeing your contributions develop into tangible projects, partnerships and results, supported by colleagues who work together to drive ideas forward.

Connect peptide discovery with early innovation.

We are looking for a Senior Peptide Scientist with deep peptide drug discovery expertise, sound scientific judgement and curiosity about new therapeutic opportunities to focus on designing, innovating, and coordinating activities that drive our drug discovery projects forward.

Your role will be shared equally between Chemistry and Drug Discovery Innovation. You will bring chemistry expertise into innovation campaigns and connect new therapeutic ideas with the knowledge and capabilities of the Chemistry department.

As an idea lead within the innovation team, you will take ownership of and contribute directly to the overall opportunity assessment, applying your understanding of the target biology and integrating specialist input to assess patient relevance, value proposition, differentiation and discovery feasibility. You will identify key risks and evidence gaps and develop clear recommendations where further investigation is needed.

Within Chemistry, you will lead the scientific design and coordination of the initial experimental phase, evaluating drug concepts in the first two project stages. You will coordinate experimental work carried out in close collaboration with the department’s laboratory technicians, draw on the expertise of scientists supporting the laboratory workflows, and interpret results with colleagues across disciplines.

As projects progress, you will ensure a clear handover of the scientific ownership to a discovery project scientist.

Your primary tasks will be to:

• Lead opportunity assessments that integrate biological rationale, human evidence, unmet medical need, the treatment landscape, strategic fit, competitive positioning and relevant intellectual property.

• Assess peptide modality fit and chemical feasibility across innovation campaigns, identifying key risks, evidence gaps and capabilities that need to be developed or accessed externally.

• Engage Chemistry scientists and coordinate specialist contributions to feasibility assessments.

• Design initial peptide compounds and experimental plans, coordinate synthesis and evaluation, and integrate findings with colleagues from Molecular Pharmacology, Computational Drug Discovery, Pharmaceutical Development, DMPK, and Translational Pharmacology.

• Present balanced recommendations on next steps and ensure a clear scientific handover when projects progress.

Deep peptide expertise and curiosity about new therapeutic opportunities

You bring substantial experience in peptide drug discovery and understand how molecular design choices shape the properties of a successful drug concept. You evaluate evidence critically, recognize uncertainty and identify the experiments needed to make a decision.

You may already have experience assessing new therapeutic opportunities, or you may be an accomplished peptide discovery scientist ready to take on broader idea leadership. In either case, you draw on colleagues’ specialist expertise while taking ownership of the overall assessment and recommendation.

Your experience and qualifications include:

• A PhD in chemistry, peptide chemistry or a related discipline, or an MSc with substantial relevant industry experience.

• Strong industry experience in peptide drug discovery, including peptide design, synthesis strategies and interpretation of structure–activity relationships.

• Experience optimizing peptide potency, selectivity, stability and exposure, using approaches relevant to the drug concept.

• The ability to integrate chemistry, analytical, biological and DMPK data to support clear scientific decisions.

• An understanding of the wider drug R&D value chain and how early target and modality choices influence later development.

Experience in early innovation, target assessment or cross-functional project coordination is an advantage. Most importantly, you are motivated to apply your peptide expertise to new therapeutic questions and develop your ability to lead opportunity assessments.

You work independently, take ownership and communicate complex science clearly. You share early ideas, challenge assumptions constructively and adapt your view as the evidence emerges. You build effective relationships and involve the right colleagues to move an assessment or experimental plan forward.

Chemistry and Drug Discovery Innovation at Gubra – your new Teams

You will be based at Gubra HQ in Hørsholm, Greater Copenhagen, working closely with colleagues in both departments. You will build a broad collaborative across multiple specialist functions network to evaluate opportunities and establish the evidence for new discovery projects.

The role offers the opportunity to influence our future project portfolio while remaining closely connected to peptide discovery. You will help make innovation a shared scientific effort by bringing ideas into Chemistry and departmental expertise into innovation decisions.

Contact and application

Please apply no later than December 1, 2026, by uploading your motivated cover letter and resume on our website.

If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact Senior Department Manager, Martin Kræmer at mkr@gubra.dk.

We are looking forward to receiving your application.

About Gubra

Gubra is a disease-agnostic techbio company specialized in peptide-based drug discovery and development as well as preclinical contract research services striving for excellence at all levels. We insist on doing things efficiently - and often differently - to reach the results we aim for. Our vision is to become leaders in the path towards a more sustainable and healthier world. We do that by facilitating the discovery of new medicine, and by acting and inspiring others to fight the ongoing climate and biodiversity crises.

Gubra’s activities are focused on the early stages of drug development and are organised in two main highly synergistic business areas: Biotech and CRO Services. We generate our revenue by performing research for life science companies as well as by partnering projects from our discovery and development pipeline.

Our therapeutic focus is within metabolic and fibrotic diseases, and we specialize in in vivo pharmacology, ex vivo assays, drug profiling, histology, stereology and whole brain and organ imaging. In addition, we offer a full palette of advanced transcriptomics. Our ML/AI-driven peptide drug discovery platform streaMLine enables us to rapidly develop a peptide hit into a non-clinical candidate ready for development. Through a constant focus on high quality, scientific excellence, speed, and solid teamwork we have established ourselves as a highly professional and competent partner in the market.

People are our greatest asset, and our team consists of around 320 employees of which many are located in Hørsholm, Denmark. The mix of people from different cultures and educational backgrounds combined with our entrepreneurial mindset have greatly impacted our working environment, which is characterized by entrepreneurial drive, scientific curiosity, and teamwork – we join forces!

jobs.description:

You will join a multidisciplinary team of six scientists and eight technicians working across upstream, downstream, and analytical disciplines. Together, we develop and characterize robust mammalian cell culture processes supporting clinical and commercial manufacturing.

**About The Job

**As a Senior Scientist, you will lead upstream late-stage development activities, with a particular focus on process characterization, down-scale model qualification, and scientific data analysis.

You will be responsible for your assigned scientific activities, from study design and data interpretation to technical recommendations and reporting. As a subject matter expert (SME), you will also serve as a key scientific contact for clients and internal stakeholders, helping explain process performance, address technical challenges, and recommend practical next steps.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Planning and leading process characterization (PC) studies, including experimental design, data evaluation, and preparation of PC work reports.

• Designing and evaluating down-scale model qualification (DSMQ) studies to demonstrate representativeness of manufacturing-scale processes.

• Applying statistical methods, including Design of Experiments (DoE), and tools such as JMP to support data-driven scientific conclusions.

• Contributing to FMECA and other process risk assessments to identify critical process parameters and support control strategy development.

• Supporting late-stage development activities, including Limit of In Vitro Cell Age (LIVCA) studies, Working Cell Bank (WCB) activities, scale-up, and technology transfer.

• Providing scientific guidance to laboratory technicians, collaborating across functions, and communicating technical findings, project status, and recommendations to clients.

You will also contribute to technical documentation, including development reports, technology transfer documentation, and relevant regulatory submissions.

**Who Are We Looking For?

**We are looking for an experienced scientist with strong technical knowledge of mammalian upstream processes and the ability to translate scientific data into practical recommendations.

**We Imagine That You

**

• Hold a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in biotechnology, biochemical engineering, or another relevant scientific discipline.

• Have at least five years of relevant industry experience with a Master's degree or two years with a PhD, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Have solid experience with mammalian cell culture processes, including bioreactor operations and scale-up.

• Have experience with late-stage process development, such as process characterization, scale-down models, or technology transfer.

• Can design studies, apply statistical methods, interpret complex data, and communicate scientifically sound conclusions.

• Have experience with process risk assessments and preparing clear scientific reports and technical documentation.

• Communicate effectively with clients and cross-functional colleagues and are fluent in written and spoken English.

Experience with JMP, DoE, AMBR250, DSMQ, FMECA, statistical equivalence testing, process modelling, or regulatory submissions will be an advantage. We recognize that candidates may bring different combinations of these skills and do not expect you to have experience with every method or technology listed.

You work independently, take responsibility for your commitments, and maintain high standards of scientific quality. You can structure your work and prioritize competing tasks, even when project requirements change.

When challenges arise, you approach them calmly and logically, communicate openly about progress and risks, and involve colleagues or your manager when support is need.

You are comfortable discussing scientific findings with clients, explaining the rationale behind your recommendations, and working with others to resolve challenges. You value mutual respect, open communication, and learning from colleagues.

**What We Offer

**At AGC Biologics, you will work on different client projects, helping prepare mammalian upstream processes for clinical and commercial manufacturing.

**We Offer

**

• The opportunity to lead late-stage upstream development studies and work on different scientific and process challenges.

• A multidisciplinary environment where scientific discussions, collaboration, and knowledge sharing are part of everyday work.

• A manager who gives you room to plan your work independently, values honest discussions, and is available when you need support.

• An initial mentoring arrangement to help you become familiar with our processes, systems, and ways of working.

• Access to our canteen arrangement, Employee Club, and employee discount opportunities.

**Interested?

**If you are motivated by combining scientific expertise, project responsibility, and client collaboration, we would like to hear from you.

Please submit your application and CV through our recruitment system. Applications will be reviewed continuously, and we reserve the right to close the job posting once we have found the right candidate.

**Expected Start Date: February 1, 2027

****Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

jobs.description:
Are you ready to bring fresh ideas to life, make an impact across channels, and help strengthen our employer brand across JYSK markets?

As our Employer Branding Coordinator, you'll help JYSK attract future colleagues through engaging digital campaigns, insights, and close collaboration with local HR teams across our markets and central departments at Head Office. You'll have the opportunity to grow your career in employer branding while combining new ideas with hands-on execution, analysis, and coordination.

This role is ideal for someone early in their career who is eager to learn, take ownership, and grow their impact over time, while also being comfortable with recurring operational and administrative tasks. We're looking for a proactive, solution-oriented person who enjoys identifying opportunities, bringing new ideas forward, and turning them into action while still respecting concepts and company rules.

The position reports to the central Employer Branding Manager at Head Office.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You will become part of the central Talent Acquisition department and play a key role in supporting both recruitment and employee experience across JYSK markets.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• Hands-on responsibility for paid employer branding and recruitment campaigns.

• An international role with close cooperation across local markets and central departments.

• Opportunities for professional and personal development.

• Room to bring forward ideas, test improvements and stay close to social media trends.

• A collaborative culture built on trust, teamwork and freedom with responsibility.

Your main focus will be to help strengthen JYSK's employer brand and attract future colleagues across our markets. You will do this through hands-on work with digital campaigns, performance insights, and close collaboration with stakeholders, continuously identifying opportunities to improve results and create impact.

Your tasks and responsibilities include:

Content & Channels

You are curious, outgoing, and eager to make things happen. You enjoy working with people, sharing ideas, and learning along the way. • Good organisational skills with the ability to manage different priorities and meet deadlines, while still keeping an eye on details.

• The ability to turn insights into meaningful, practical actions, informed by data.

• A collaborative, flexible approach and a willingness to support local markets and departments.

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? APPLY TODAY!

We kindly ask you to only attach your CV. With us, there is no need to write a traditional cover letter when applying for a job.

jobs.occupation: Senior Integration & Data Architect
jobs.description:
Stibo DX is the company behind Cue, our multimedia enterprise platform used by media organizations around the world to create, manage, and deliver content across digital and print channels.

As Cue evolves from self-hosted and hybrid deployments towards a standardized, cloud-native SaaS platform, the way our platform connects, exchanges data, and governs information is becoming increasingly important. Creating greater consistency across APIs, integrations, events, schemas, and data ownership is therefore one of our key architectural priorities.

As our Senior Integration & Data Architect, you will take ownership of shaping a more unified, governed, and decoupled integration and data architecture across Cue. You will help us tackle fragmentation and inconsistency across the platform and establish clear architectural patterns that enable our product and engineering teams to build and evolve solutions with greater speed and confidence.

This is very much a hands-on architecture role. You will not simply define principles and governance from a distance. You will work directly with teams on real designs, APIs, event contracts, integrations, schemas, and data domains, helping translate architectural direction into solutions that work in practice. You will work with modern architectural approaches and technologies such as API-first design, GraphQL/REST, Kafka, CDC, schema evolution, and multi-tenant SaaS.

You will become part of a small, but senior architecture team with significant autonomy, visibility, and responsibility. Working closely with our Platform Architect, who focuses on runtime, multi-tenancy, and observability, and our Senior Software Architect, who focuses on domain boundaries and solution design, you will have the opportunity to influence how the entire Cue platform develops as we continue our SaaS transformation.

You will report to the Director of Solution Architecture, and you will work within an architecture governance model keeping decisions close to the teams, while applying the right level of architectural guidance based on risk. The role can be based at any of our offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Oslo, Málaga, or Hamburg, depending on where you are located.

Key responsibilities

• Define and govern the unified API strategy for CUE (REST and GraphQL), design standards, versioning, deprecation, breaking-change discipline, and consistency across teams.

• Design integration patterns for a modular, microservices-based platform, sync vs async, anti-corruption layers, adapters, and migration from bespoke customer integrations to standardized platform interfaces; guide teams on when to use events vs APIs and how to avoid tight coupling.

• Own event-driven architecture on Kafka, topic design, event contracts, schema evolution, CDC/streaming, and consistency models (ordering, idempotency, replay).

• Establish data domains and governance, ownership models, schema definition and evolution, metadata, lineage, quality, classification, retention, and compliance readiness.

• Align contracts with domain boundaries, connect bounded contexts, domain events, and service ownership to API, event, and data design, in close collaboration with the Software Architect.

• Enable teams through architecture leadership, produce reference architectures and integration blueprints, shepherd ADRs, review high-risk designs, and coach teams on better patterns without blocking delivery.

• Reduce fragmentation and drive consolidation, identify one-off approaches early and steer teams toward reusable platform standards.

• Partner across architecture and delivery, work with platform, product, and engineering teams to ensure standards are usable, adopted, and durable.

What you will bring

You are someone who naturally takes ownership and looks beyond individual solutions to understand what is best for the platform as a whole. You notice fragmentation, inconsistencies, and emerging risks, and you are proactive in bringing people together to find practical ways forward.

You are comfortable working across engineering, architecture, and product, and you know how to turn complex integration and data topics into clear, pragmatic decisions that teams can actually work with. You build credibility through your expertise, but also through collaboration, listening, and an understanding that strong architecture needs to support delivery rather than slow it down.

You believe in strong standards where they matter, while taking a pragmatic, risk-based approach to governance. You are curious and adaptable, care about quality and maintainability, and are motivated by creating clarity around contracts, data ownership, and architectural boundaries. Ultimately, you enjoy bringing coherence to complex platforms and leaving them in a better architectural state than you found them.

Experience

• 10+ years in software engineering, integration engineering, data engineering, or architecture, with 5+ years in a senior role focused on integration, APIs, events, and/or data architecture.

• Proven experience designing and governing APIs in large, distributed, multi-team environments.

• Strong experience with REST and GraphQL API design, versioning, and contract-first approaches.

• Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture in production, preferably Kafka.

• Experience with integration patterns: messaging, pub/sub, request/reply, outbox, saga/process manager, and CDC.

• Strong understanding of schema modeling and schema evolution for APIs and events.

• Experience defining data domains, ownership models, and data governance in a product or platform context.

• Ability to connect Domain-Driven Design (DDD) concepts (bounded contexts, domain events, aggregates) to integration and data design.

• Understanding of AWS, Kubernetes-based platforms, and multi-tenant SaaS implications for data isolation and integration boundaries.

• Security-aware design across APIs and events, authentication, authorization, zero-trust principles.

Interested?

Please apply here on LinkedIn. You are encouraged to apply at your earliest convenience. Short-listed candidates will be invited for an interview. Applications are processed as they are received until the right candidate is found.

Should you have questions about the position, you are also welcome to contact Director, Safdar Aqeel via mail safs@stibodx.com. We look forward to hearing from you.

Help us empower storytellers across the globe

Stibo DX is the global leader in digital transformation for media enterprises. Our platform and services help automate complex content production and enable omnichannel delivery for some of the world's most ambitious and successful media organizations.

We are a global and dynamic team of over 200 employees based in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Atlanta, Hamburg, Oslo, and Málaga, combining creativity and innovation with the stability of a long-standing organization.

Stibo DX is part of the Stibo Software Group, the second-largest Danish-owned software group. Our roots trace back to the Stibo Foundation, which has a 228-year history and a rich legacy that supports our continued growth.

Among our customers are The New York Times, Hearst, Gannett, The Economist, A-Media, JP/Politikens Hus, Mediahuis, The Hindu, and many others.

If you want to be part of a team where individuals are valued and trust is a driver, we encourage you to apply today!

Read the Stibo DX story and about working at Stibo DX here.
